notes.title: 💀 Host Mortem Dev Dispatch
notes.content:
:warning: [b]NOTE:[/b] [b]Host Mortem[/b] is not out [i]yet [/i]— but you can wishlist it and help raise it from the dead:
:point_right: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629620/Host_Mortem/]Wishlist NOW![/url]

It’s been a productive few weeks in the crypt. Here’s what we’ve summoned, stitched, and reanimated in [u]Host Mortem[/u] — the rogue-like where you’re already dead, and things only get worse from there.
[h2]🧠 AI Upgrades: Now With 87% More Regret[/h2]
The monsters in [u]Host Mortem[/u] have evolved from wandering meatbags into cunning horrors with actual brain cells (well, metaphorical ones). We've wired in full [b]behavior trees[/b], meaning:[list]  [*]Goblins flee and flank like cowards with ambition.[/*]  [*]Slimes wobble with intent.[/*]  [*]Beholders drift ominously with that [u]“I read minds and judge”[/u] vibe.[/*][/list]Enemies now patrol, chase, and hesitate. You’ll even see [b]thought bubbles[/b] showing what they [u]think[/u] they’re doing. (Hint: it’s rarely helpful for you.)
[h2]⚔️ Combat Polish: Now With More Ouch[/h2]
Attacks now hit where they should (mostly), and when they do, you’ll know it — thanks to:[list]  [*][b]Improved hurtboxes[/b], direction-based swings, and animated pain.[/*]  [*]Every entity gets a [b]health bar[/b]. So you can watch them suffer with clarity.[/*]  [*]Unique death animations for each foe. Because everyone dies a little differently.[/*][/list]
[h2]👻 Possession Overhaul: Ghost Mode Engaged[/h2]
Possession is the name of the game — literally — and now it feels like it:[list]  [*]Hosts now glow with shader-driven [u]“please haunt me”[/u] energy.[/*]  [*]Visual FX make entering and exiting bodies feel spiritually satisfying.[/*]  [*]A reliable [b]dehost[/b] mechanic lets you bail before your ride decomposes.[/*][/list]Possession isn't just a mechanic now — it's a lifestyle.
[h2]🎨 Visuals & UI: More Dead, More Sexy[/h2]
[list]  [*][b]New level art[/b], [b]mood lighting[/b], and polished visual FX breathe eerie life into the crypt.[/*]  [*]The UI got a cleanup too — menus that actually behave, controller support, and a main menu that doesn’t look like a placeholder. (Because it’s not anymore.)[/*][/list]
[h2]🌍 Global Reach: Possessors of the World, Unite[/h2]
We’re not just haunting in English anymore. [u]Host Mortem[/u] is now playable in:[list]  [*]🇺🇸 English[/*]  [*]🇪🇸 Spanish[/*]  [*]🇯🇵 Japanese[/*][/list]More to come, depending on who raises their hand... or claw.
[h2]🕹️ Steam Integration: The Ghost Is Out of the Vault[/h2]
[list]  [*][b]Achievements?[/b] Done.[/*]  [*][b]Rich presence?[/b] You bet.[/*]  [*][b]Marketing materials?[/b] We summoned them via blood ritual (and Inkscape).[/*][/list]We’re [b]fully armed and operational[/b] for the Steam launch. All that’s missing is your wishlists.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629620/Host_Mortem/][b]👉 Wishlist Host Mortem on Steam[/b][/url]

[u]Yes, this link is haunted. Yes, you should click it anyway.[/u]
[h2]🎵 QoL & Vibes[/h2]
[list]  [*][b]Pause menu?[/b] Yes.[/*]  [*][b]Options screen?[/b] Absolutely.[/*]  [*][b]Background music?[/b] Finally.[/*]  [*][b]Bugs squashed?[/b] So many.[/*]  [*][b]Gamepad support?[/b] You can now die comfortably from the couch.[/*][/list]

Want to see more behind the scenes? I post development updates, sneak peeks, and hauntings on [url=https://patreon.com/GhostRZZR]Patreon[/url] and [url=https://twitch.tv/GhostRZZR]Twitch[/url]. Come hang out. Or die trying.

— [u]GhostRZZR, Out.[/u]
